title: Background Radiation
description: Home Geiger readings compared with public government radiation networks

options.markdown:
### Home sensor
Local monitor from `index=radsensor` (`cpm` and `usvh`). Government feeds are stored as `sourcetype=gov:radiation:json` and excluded here.

### World vs home
Live public networks: **Germany BfS ODL-Info** (total ambient uSv/h), **Health Canada FPS** (terrestrial nSv/h converted to uSv/h), **Finland STUK** (outdoor uSv/h). Canada is terrestrial-only, so it usually reads lower than total-dose networks. Typical published ranges are in the lookup table.

viz_world_line.title: Home vs government medians over time

options.query:
index=radsensor sourcetype!=gov:radiation:json
| timechart span=10m avg(cpm) as CPM avg(usvh) as uSv_h

index=radsensor sourcetype!=gov:radiation:json
| stats latest(cpm) as cpm

index=radsensor sourcetype!=gov:radiation:json
| stats latest(usvh) as usvh

index=radsensor sourcetype=gov:radiation:json event_type=network_summary source_network="All government networks"
| stats latest(median_usvh) as median_usvh

index=radsensor sourcetype!=gov:radiation:json
| stats latest(usvh) as home_usvh
| appendcols [
  search index=radsensor sourcetype=gov:radiation:json event_type=network_summary source_network="All government networks"
  | stats latest(median_usvh) as world_usvh
]
| eval delta_usvh=round(home_usvh-world_usvh, 4)
| fields delta_usvh

index=radsensor sourcetype!=gov:radiation:json
| stats latest(usvh) as home_usvh
| appendcols [
  search index=radsensor sourcetype=gov:radiation:json event_type=network_summary source_network="All government networks"
  | stats latest(median_usvh) as world_usvh
]
| eval ratio=round(home_usvh/world_usvh, 2)
| fields ratio

index=radsensor sourcetype!=gov:radiation:json
| stats latest(usvh) as home_usvh
| appendcols [
  search index=radsensor sourcetype=gov:radiation:json event_type=network_summary source_network="All government networks"
  | stats latest(median_usvh) as world_usvh
]
| eval comparison=case(
  isnull(world_usvh), "Waiting for government feed",
  home_usvh > world_usvh*1.5, "Home is higher than the live world median",
  home_usvh < world_usvh*0.67, "Home is lower than the live world median",
  1=1, "Home is similar to the live world median")
| fields comparison

index=radsensor sourcetype!=gov:radiation:json
| stats latest(usvh) as usvh
| eval source_network="Home sensor"
| append [
  search index=radsensor sourcetype=gov:radiation:json event_type=network_summary source_network!="All government networks"
  | stats latest(median_usvh) as usvh by source_network
]
| table source_network usvh
| sort usvh

index=radsensor sourcetype!=gov:radiation:json
| eval series="Home sensor"
| eval usvh_plot=usvh
| append [
  search index=radsensor sourcetype=gov:radiation:json event_type=network_summary
  | eval series=source_network
  | eval usvh_plot=median_usvh
]
| timechart span=1h avg(usvh_plot) by series

index=radsensor sourcetype=gov:radiation:json event_type=network_summary
| stats latest(median_usvh) as median_usvh latest(avg_usvh) as avg_usvh latest(p10_usvh) as p10_usvh latest(p90_usvh) as p90_usvh latest(min_usvh) as min_usvh latest(max_usvh) as max_usvh latest(station_count) as station_count latest(country) as country latest(dose_component) as dose_component by source_network
| append [
  search index=radsensor sourcetype!=gov:radiation:json
  | stats latest(usvh) as home_usvh
  | eval source_network="__HOME__"
]
| eventstats max(home_usvh) as home_usvh
| where source_network!="__HOME__"
| eval home_minus_network=round(home_usvh-median_usvh, 4)
| eval home_ratio=round(home_usvh/median_usvh, 2)
| table source_network country dose_component station_count median_usvh avg_usvh p10_usvh p90_usvh min_usvh max_usvh home_usvh home_minus_network home_ratio
| sort source_network

| inputlookup typical_background.csv
| table region network agency typical_usvh range_low_usvh range_high_usvh dose_component citation

index=radsensor sourcetype=gov:radiation:json event_type=station
| stats latest(usvh) as usvh latest(country) as country latest(lat) as lat latest(lon) as lon latest(dose_component) as dose_component latest(measured_at) as measured_at by station_name source_network
| sort - usvh
| head 50
| eval usvh=round(usvh, 4)
| table measured_at source_network country station_name usvh dose_component lat lon

index=radsensor sourcetype=gov:radiation:json event_type=station lat=* lon=*
| stats latest(usvh) as usvh latest(lat) as lat latest(lon) as lon latest(country) as country by station_name source_network
| eval usvh=round(usvh, 4)
